subject.title: Limpiar HTML inválido que causará hydration errors (nesting de DOM) en todo el monorepo

question: Should this issue stay as one large monorepo-wide cleanup, or should maintainers split it into a focused admin-first repair plus follow-up sweep items?
rationale: The source evidence confirms real remaining admin bugs, but the issue asks for a broad cross-app sweep and visual/browser validation that may exceed a safe autonomous repair boundary.

options.title: Split admin-first repair
options.body: Fix the confirmed admin patterns first and open or keep follow-up tracking for any remaining ecommerce, data-dashboards, or supply findings discovered by search and smoke testing.

options.title: Keep one large sweep
options.body: Assign this as a larger frontend task that covers all apps and requires complete browser smoke proof before closing.

options.title: Narrow acceptance to admin
options.body: If maintainers only need the confirmed console warnings cleaned up now, update acceptance to admin and leave wider pattern hardening for normal maintenance.

recommendation.title: Split admin-first repair
recommendation.body: Fix the confirmed admin patterns first and open or keep follow-up tracking for any remaining ecommerce, data-dashboards, or supply findings discovered by search and smoke testing.

likelyOwner.reason: They reported the issue from the Next 16 admin smoke pass and have recent payment/admin context for deciding how much of that sweep is required for acceptance.
